meta.title: Confident with AI — Your own AI assistant | Ebmeyer Consulting
meta.description: For established entrepreneurs and solopreneurs: an end to AI chaos. In 4–6 weeks to your own AI assistant and a clear strategy.

hero.title: Confident with AI
hero.lead: An end to AI chaos and lost hours. Your own assistant supports your business — and you stay in the lead.

pain.title: You're successful. But you carry all of it alone.

items.title: You're losing valuable time.
items.body: Proposals, posts, emails, research, admin: too many manual steps end up with you. Hour after hour that your clients and your growth never get.

items.title: AI could help — but where do you start?
items.body: Between a thousand tools, tutorials and hype, you never find the thread. You've been experimenting for months without anything really landing in your business.

items.title: You watch others pick up speed.
items.body: And quietly sense it: you're falling behind while you're still deciding where to begin.

items.title: The most honest question.
items.body: How much longer do you want to trade your time for money and lose energy on tasks a well-built AI could have taken over long ago?

pain.pull: There is another way. Confident, systematic, and without making yourself dependent on anyone.

cost.title: Every month without a system costs you more than what's on the invoice.

rows.body: Hours you pour week after week into things that could long since have been delegated.
Energy that drains away in the tool jungle instead of flowing into your client relationships.
The gap to those already using AI with confidence grows every month.

cost.statBody: Just 5 hours a week that your assistant takes over is more than 250 hours a year — back for growth, clients and you.
cost.statNote: Not a revenue promise, but an invitation to do the maths on your time again.

approach.title: You don't need many tools. You need clarity and an assistant that supports you.
approach.lead: Confident with AI isn't another course showing you one more tool. It's the path from «let me try something» to «my business runs on a system, with me at the wheel».

cards.title: Strategy and system, not tool chaos
cards.body: You get a clear plan for which AI actually gives you leverage, and a system that supports your day instead of adding to it.

cards.title: An expert who knows your world
cards.body: From solopreneur to corporate, across industries: I know very different kinds of organisations and how AI works in your specific context.

cards.title: Enablement, not dependency
cards.body: You learn to run your AI assistant yourself and to set up new automations on your own. In the end you won't need me — and that is exactly the goal.

cards.title: From real experience
cards.body: 21+ years of practice and people already working with me: from big pharma to e-commerce solopreneurs, coaches, consultants and therapists.

journey.title: Foundation first. Then depth.
journey.lead: You start with Phase 1, your foundation. It stands on its own and gets you to a working AI assistant. Phase 2 is the optional deepening: the more your assistant is tailored to you, the more powerful it becomes. That's where the biggest leverage sits.

journey.pull: Phase 1 gets you ready. Phase 2 makes you confident.
